summary: End-to-end testing of the new 'When There Wasn't Enough' (WTWE) feature — 5 real bookable events, dedicated story page, menu page, /menus + /suppers 3rd card, per-event pricing override, and site_content 'wtwe' block. Backend: 11 passed / 1 skipped (regression-only skip). Frontend: full booking flow verified end-to-end (form -> UPI QR -> screenshot upload -> confirmed). Pricing model change is backwards-compatible — Barsaat still uses global ₹2,500 veg / ₹2,800 non-veg.
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): The wrapper grid on /supper-club/when-there-wasnt-enough uses data-testid='wtwe-date-grid'. This collides with the prefix query [data-testid^="wtwe-date-"] used in selectors, returning 6 elements instead of 5. Consider renaming the container to 'wtwe-dates-grid' to avoid selector ambiguity in future tests. Visually only the 5 real date cards render — no functional issue.

MINOR (non-blocking): The 'Now booking' pill on /menus wtwe card is present visually (rendered via CSS badge) but the text was not picked up via page.inner_text() during automation — confirmed present in the DOM/HTML. No user-facing bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_calc_total` correctly reads event.price_veg / event.price_nonveg and falls back to global settings — good backward compatibility for Barsaat/Naani Ghar events (verified via live booking that produced total=2500 for global veg).
Migration `wtwe_events_v1` is idempotent (checks db.migrations before running) — safe on restarts.
server.py file is ~1750 lines. Consider splitting into modules (events, registrations, admin, media, content) for maintainability. Not blocking.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 executed passed; 1 regression test skipped only because no self-service skip fixture, verified manually via curl instead)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for core WTWE flows (home #events, /menus, /menus/wtwe, /supper-club/wtwe, /suppers, full booking + screenshot upload + confirmed state)

seed_data_creation: None. Test-created bookings were cleaned up (all wtwe events reset to seats_booked=0; barsaat regression booking also cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WTWE feature is fully functional. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_wtwe_feature.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set). All 5 wtwe events (wtwe-2026-08-23-lunch, 08-30-dinner, 09-06-lunch, 09-11-dinner, 09-13-lunch) exist with price_veg=price_nonveg=2800, seats_total=8, tag='When There Wasn't Enough'. Barsaat events continue to use global settings pricing (verified live). Admin dashboard UI tabs (Events/Menu/CMS) were not deep-tested via Playwright but underlying APIs are healthy — main agent can self-verify if needed.
